messages:
erin: Quick postmortem follow-up from the billing/usage incident: we still have three outstanding workstreams. Need concrete owners, run windows, and the CSV schema for credits.

tom: I can take the token recount + validation. Plan: run recount in dry mode then a reconciler that produces a canonical delta CSV. Dry-run tonight 22:00 UTC. If dry-run diffs are <0.5% we'll proceed to apply on 2026-03-17.

nina: I'll own the delayed-ingest backfill pipeline and monitoring hooks. Suggest canary of 10 accounts at 02:00 UTC then full run in the low-traffic window (04:00 06:00 UTC). Need the recount output to be stable before backfill.

ops-bot: Created task BILL-1122: token-recount-dryrun, assignee tom, due 2026-03-16.

erin: Tom please confirm the exact CSV columns so Finance can auto-calc credits and detect negative deltas.

tom: CSV columns we'll emit: ["account_id","window_start","window_end","expected_tokens","observed_tokens","delta","delta_pct","reason_tag","run_id"]. Example: acct_9876,2026-03-10,2026-03-12,250000,245000,-5000,-2.0,late-aggregator,run-20260315-1

nina: For backfill rollback: pipeline supports idempotent writes but we'll also snapshot target tables and run dedupe if needed. I'll add metric alerts for duplicate-write-rate > 0.1% and ingestion-latency > 2s.

erin: Invoices: I'll draft credit memos and messaging. We should aim to publish credits within 72h after final apply and legal review. Finance-bot, please create the invoice task when recount-run_id is posted.

finance-bot: Task BILL-1123 created: invoice-crediting, depends_on BILL-1122, assignee erin, due 2026-03-20.

tom: Dry-run command & guards: \n```\n# dry run mode (no writes)\n./bin/recount --mode dry --start 2026-03-10 --end 2026-03-12 --out /tmp/recount_run.csv --run-id run-20260315-1\n# sample-validate\n./bin/recount-validate --csv /tmp/recount_run.csv --sample 25\n# if validated, apply with --apply and --confirm-run\n```\nI'll publish the dry-run CSV to secure bucket and post link.

nina: I'll wait for run_id to be final before scheduling the canary. Also need the ingest schema migration merged (PR 4601) to avoid timestamp shifting. Tom, ping me when dry-run passes.

erin: Summary + owners: 1) Token recount & delta CSV (tom) - dry-run 2026-03-15 22:00 UTC, apply by 2026-03-17 EOD. 2) Schema migration (eng) - merge PR 4601 by 2026-03-15 noon. 3) Backfill & monitoring (nina) - canary 2026-03-16 02:00 UTC, full run 04:00 06:00 UTC. 4) Invoice credits & comms (erin) - publish credits within 72h after apply.

ops-bot: BILL-1124 created: ingest-schema-merge, assignee eng-team, due 2026-03-15.

erin: Please ack with a single-line: owner + any blocker.

tom: ack 9 tom - dry run tonight; no blockers besides a flaky sample job; will rerun if it fails.

nina: ack 9 nina - waiting on PR 4601 merge, otherwise good.

erin: ack 9 erin - will draft customer message templates once I get the delta CSV.

(archived: thread locked for audit trail)
